race.comment: LAUNCHER (6) is a clear danger after charging home from well back to win a BM55 at this track, and his distance and synthetic records support the rise to this grade. TRANSGRESS (5) hasn't been far away in stronger recent assignments, with a wide run and interference last start at Ipswich adding merit to a 2.5L-defeat. LENNYSTAR (8) brings honest country CL2 form, including a Lismore win and a Casino third. Her synthetic record keeps her in the mix. BLITZGAL (2) was good fresh but has failed to go on with it since. Stable will be hoping the move north can spark her back up.
